tags.name: Admin - UserRequest
tags.description: Admin user request management (list, update status, delete)

provider.description: Use 'email' or 'google'. If a user has both, the stored value will be 'email,google'. Legacy input 'both' is still accepted.

allowMerge.description: Legacy flag (accepted but no longer required)

post.description: Authenticate admin by email and password via Supabase. Returns access/refresh tokens and synced admin user.
Register a new admin via Supabase (email/password).
Verify OTP code sent to email by Supabase.
Create or update an admin in Prisma after Supabase authentication. May upgrade role to Admin.

403.description: Token does not match provided user data

delete.summary: Delete medication logs by time range
delete.description: Delete medication logs for selected users within a specific time range.
Permanently delete a user and all their data (profiles, logs, relations). Requires 'CONFIRM' string.

get.description: List admin accounts for dashboard management.
Get usage stats per account (profile count and medication log count). You can filter by date range using fromDate / toDate.

patch.description: Update the status (active/banned) of a user by userId.

status.description: true for active, false for banned

delete.description: Delete an admin account by userId. Optionally provide email as a query param.

get.description: List medicines for admin screens (id + names). Supports search, type filter, and A-Z/Z-A ordering.
Return full medicine data by mediId.
Return how many medicines exist in the system. By default counts only non-deleted records. Set includeDeleted=true to include soft-deleted rows.

post.description: Create a new medicine record. Supports optional picture upload.

patch.description: Update an existing medicine. Provide mediId and any fields to update. Supports optional new picture upload.

get.description: List all user requests with optional filters by status, type, and search.

patch.description: Update the status of a user request. Admin ID is automatically set.

delete.description: Delete a user request. Picture file is also deleted if exists.
